title.tr: Havuz Kenarında Ahşap Deck ve Küçük Köprü
title.en: Wooden Pool Deck with a Small Footbridge

alt.tr: Serbest formlu havuzun çevresinde ahşap deck ve havuzun üzerinden geçen korkuluklu küçük ahşap köprü, arkada bahçe ve köşkler
alt.en: Freeform pool surrounded by a wooden deck, with a small railed wooden footbridge across it and garden pavilions behind

caption.tr: Serbest formlu havuzun kenarı ahşap deckle kaplandı, havuzun üzerine korkuluklu küçük bir ahşap köprü kuruldu. Havuz henüz boş.
caption.en: The edge of this freeform pool is covered with a wooden deck, and a small railed wooden footbridge spans the pool. The pool is still empty.
